evidence.quote: Congress appointed on June 10 a committee of five to draft a statement of independence for the colonies.
Jefferson drafted the statement between June 11 and 28
The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.
Finally, in the afternoon of July 4th, the Declaration was adopted.
the approved Declaration was printed on July 5th
On July 19th, Congress ordered that the Declaration be engrossed on parchment with a new title,
It was engrossed on parchment and on August 2, 1776, delegates began signing it.
On August 2nd John Hancock, the President of the Congress, signed the engrossed copy with a bold signature.
